controls: Carrier must require the exact continuation_key and propagate it to every child stage and receipt.
Carrier task version and pickup revision must equal a fresh remote queue readback immediately before entrypoint execution.
Canonical repo root and all executable parents must reject Windows reparse-point or junction escape.
Resolved Git executable path version and file hash must be recorded and remain stable through the run.
Python executable environment and required package versions must be receipted before numeric stages.
Required Fiona Rasterio Shapely PyProj NumPy Requests and lxml imports must pass a pinned compatibility matrix.
Process locale must not alter decimal serialization parsing or subprocess arguments.
Carrier and child timestamps must use UTC with a receipted process timezone.
Every child process working directory must equal the canonical Git toplevel.
Cancellation or console termination must emit a deterministic blocked receipt and clean descendants.
Carrier must place entrypoint and descendants in a bounded Windows job object for full-tree cleanup.
Entrypoint standard streams must use deterministic UTF-8 and preserve structured terminal status.
Unknown AAYS environment overrides must be rejected or explicitly allowlisted.
Expected web row environment value must be a strict bounded decimal integer and never bool float or signed text.
PowerShell host path edition version architecture and effective execution policy must be recorded.
Carrier and all pinned executable blobs must be rehashed after execution to detect mid-run mutation.
Remote canonical HEAD must be reread after entrypoint and match the run start identity before acceptance.
Bounded free disk memory and temporary-directory capacity must be checked before large downloads.
Official HMLR EA and OS hosts require bounded DNS and TLS preflight receipts before the stage starts.
Each run must use a unique run_id output directory with latest pointers updated only after acceptance.
Recovery must pin origin fetch and push URLs to the canonical repository identity.
Atomic fetch must use an exact branch refspec and must not accept an ambiguous local or tag ref.
Git safe.directory and repository ownership configuration must be explicitly receipted.
Before sync recovery must inspect lock owner process and age and remove only proven stale empty locks.
Dirty recovery must prove refs/stash advanced exactly once and identify the created stash commit.
Stash message must bind slot task attempt continuation and run_id.
Snapshot must bound and receipt unusually large untracked files before stash to avoid indefinite pending.
Submodule and Git LFS state must be absent or explicitly clean and pinned before ff-only synchronization.
Helper PowerShell executable path and hash must be pinned rather than relying on the command name.
Helper timeout must terminate the complete descendant tree and verify no matching process remains.
CIM process-query failure must block restart rather than being interpreted as zero processes.
Processes with unreadable command lines must make canonical process count ambiguous and block start.
The observed daemon PID start time executable and command hash must remain stable across verification.
Daemon heartbeat must be atomically written and bound to file SHA owner lease and daemon PID.
Restart success requires a heartbeat timestamp that advances after the launcher start time.
Queue claim must use remote compare-and-swap and fail if task bytes changed since preflight.
Owner lease and heartbeat must carry the same lease-token hash and monotonically increasing version.
Restart receipt must distinguish daemon start from the later observed exact task claim.
A transient or legacy process without persistent daemon and fresh heartbeat must never return exit zero.
Launcher CMD and fallback devam.ps1 bytes must be pinned and recorded before either is executed.
Canonical launcher and fallback launch must be protected by one mutex and never overlap.
Launcher process early exit before daemon observation must record its exit code and block.
Multiple-daemon detection must block and preserve processes; automated killing is forbidden without ownership proof.
Heartbeat timestamps too far in the future or before process start must fail closed.
Recovery receipts must use same-volume temporary write flush and atomic rename semantics.
Every required receipt must use an accepted exact schema version and reject unknown safety-critical fields.
Error command and environment fields must redact credentials cookies and bearer tokens.
Manual-action updates must compare the current canonical blob and source HEAD before mutation.
A resolved manual action may reopen only on a new coherent blocker receipt and preserved transition history.
Final acceptance requires remote readback of receipt path blob SHA and canonical branch HEAD.
Seed parcel_id must equal parcel_<row_no> with canonical decimal formatting.
Seed rank and array order must exactly follow target rows 30762 46142 and 61522.
Seed download URLs must use approved HTTPS path with no credentials fragment or unexpected query.
Catalogue session cookies must be Secure host-scoped and excluded from redirected non-HMLR requests.
All three authority links must come from one catalogue response and one publication release.
Failed or retried downloads must quarantine partial bytes and never reuse the final filename.
Encrypted ZIP members must be rejected before extraction.
ZIP members representing symlinks devices or other special files must be rejected.
GML byte-order mark XML declaration and decoded encoding must agree.
Each authority archive must yield the expected unique current GML application document.
Production fresh matching must accept only official GML rather than GeoJSON GPKG or Shapefile alternatives.
Selected Fiona layer must match the expected INSPIRE cadastral application schema.
Official source CRS and axis order must prove British National Grid coordinates before matching.
Conflicting feature id and identifier-like property values must block exact matching.
Identifier comparison must use a defined Unicode normalization without lossy whitespace collapse.
Every geometry coordinate must be finite and within plausible British National Grid bounds.
Unexpected Z or M dimensions must be rejected or deterministically removed with a receipt.
Exact official geometry must not be silently snapped or rounded before point and area checks.
Invalid geometry repair must retain original and repaired geometry hashes and topology summary.
Point coverage decision must record exact boundary distance without an implicit tolerance.
A selected feature must originate from the authority directory specified by its seed.
Chosen polygon result must propagate authority archive and member SHA lineage.
Matcher must impose and receipt bounded per-layer and total feature counts.
Long feature scans must emit progress heartbeats and respond to cancellation before the stage deadline.
WKT and GeoJSON representations must hash the same normalized geometry and reproduce the stored area.
EA WCS base URL must use the official HTTPS host and path without userinfo fragment or unexpected query.
Capabilities and DescribeCoverage must return bounded XML media types with consistent character encoding.
Capabilities must contain one WCS service namespace and advertised 2.0.1 version.
DescribeCoverage must return exactly one CoverageDescription for the pinned CoverageId.
Axis labels must bind grid envelope positions and BNG easting/northing semantics without fallback defaults.
GetCoverage subset bounds must use canonical fixed-decimal formatting and no locale or scientific notation.
Final GetCoverage URL must be bounded and contain exactly the required duplicate subset parameters only.
Raster acceptance requires HTTP 200 and must reject partial-content or range responses.
GeoTIFF endian marker and first IFD must be structurally valid before Rasterio sampling.
Raster dimensions transform and bounds must cover the padded requested envelope without excessive expansion.
One-metre grid origin must align to the declared CRS with consistent half-pixel centre semantics.
Mask geometry hash and EPSG:27700 identity must match the fresh HMLR result used for the request.
Scale offset and conversion to float64 must reject overflow underflow and sentinel leakage.
Each sample row must include a canonical request hash alongside the GeoTIFF response hash.
Opened GeoTIFF bounds must contain the exact unpadded polygon used for pixel-centre sampling.
Product IDs and names that normalize to the same Terrain50 label must block ambiguous selection.
Selected download filename and area fields must bind the required 100km area and official grid format.
Download redirect chains require a small maximum hop count and approved method preservation.
ZIP end-of-central-directory uniqueness and trailing-byte policy must be validated.
ASCII origin headers must agree with the tile code and documented north-west data origin.
A 200 by 200 grid must contain exactly 40000 elevation tokens after the header.
GML grid envelope sequence and external data reference must bind the selected ASC cell stream hash.
Child and canonical index pages must prohibit remote active content and unsafe inline navigation.
Every JSON asset must use application/json nosniff and no-store or validator-consistent caching.
Latest pointer qa_latest bundle and rendered range must be remotely reread and SHA-bound after publishing.
